item.scanner:headline: Receives 13D/A from 3i, LP; stake now 9.9%
item.description:
Receives 13D/A from 3i, LP; stake now 9.9%

3i, LP filed an amended Schedule 13D/A on Valion Bio, increasing its beneficial ownership to 2,102,780 shares (9.9% of common stock) through conversions of Series B and C preferred stock and a senior secured convertible note. The stake is subject to a 9.99% blocker. This reflects continued accumulation by the investor.

About: Valion Bio, Inc. operates as a late-stage biopharmaceutical company. Its lead drug candidate is Entolimod, a TLR5 agonist that is in late-stage development to treat acute radiation syndrome. The company’s pipeline also comprises Entolimod to treat Neutropenia and lymphocyte exhaustion; and Entolasta, an immunologically optimized variant of Entolimod for chronic applications, such as immunosenescence. In addition, it offers CDMO services.

  • Counterparty: 3i, LP

item.title: ⚖️ Litigation · Won · NUTX
item.scanner:headline: Wins en banc ruling: ghost rates barred, bonus/incentive payments must be included in QPA
item.description:
Wins en banc ruling: ghost rates barred, bonus/incentive payments must be included in QPA

Reported the Fifth Circuit en banc vacated key portions of the July 2021 rule under the No Surprises Act, barring insurers from using 'ghost rates' and requiring inclusion of bonus/incentive payments in QPA calculations. This favorable ruling should increase provider reimbursement rates. The court directed HHS to allow insurers to continue using existing QPAs until new rules are issued.

About: Nutex Health Inc. operates as a healthcare services and operations company in the United States. It operates through three segments: Hospital, Population Health Management (PHM), and Real Estate. The Hospital segment develops and operates a network of micro hospitals, specialty hospitals, and hospital outpatient departments that offer healthcare services, including emergency room care, inpatient care, and behavioural health.

  • Announced: 2026-08-11
  • Next catalyst: New QPA rules from HHS
